title: What is it Like to Work for Elon Musk?
summary: A 12-minute clip from Joe Rogan's podcast in which former NASA astronaut Garrett Reisman describes working for Elon Musk at SpaceX. He discusses Musk's engineering breadth, his Mars-focused decision making and the stress of the job.
why: HN uses it as a firsthand account from an astronaut who worked with Musk, cited in arguments about Musk's engineering ability and SpaceX culture.

quote.text: Watch this interview with a former Astronaut who worked with SpaceX for Crew Dragon.
